translations.overview: Un teen-ager depresso e alienato decide di dare una mano all'amico Pedro, candidato alla presidenza del corpo studentesco, mentre fa i conti con una bizzarra situazione familiare.
A listless and alienated teenager decides to help his new friend win the class presidency in their small western high school, while he must deal with his bizarre family life back home.
translations.tagline: He's out to prove he's got nothing to prove.
